trials.title: Phase II Study of Targeted EGFR-Bispecific Antibody Combination in Treatment-Naive EGFR-Mutant Advanced Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
trials.briefTitle: EGFR-Bispecific Study in First-Line EGFR+ NSCLC
trials.summary: Multi-center Phase II open-label study evaluating safety and progression-free survival of a targeted EGFR/MET bispecific regimen in adults with locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC harboring EGFR exon 19 deletion or L858R mutation.
trials.eligibilityCriteriaRaw:
Inclusion Criteria:
1. Age >= 18 years at time of informed consent.
2. Histologically confirmed Stage IIIB or Stage IV Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC).
3. Documented activating EGFR mutation (Exon 19 deletion or Exon 21 L858R).
4. ECOG performance status of 0 or 1.
5. Absolute Neutrophil Count (ANC) >= 1500 /µL, Platelets >= 100000 /µL, Hemoglobin >= 9.0 g/dL.
6. Adequate renal function defined as eGFR >= 45 mL/min.

Exclusion Criteria:
1. Prior systemic therapy with an EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitor (TKI) for metastatic disease.
2. Known active or untreated symptomatic central nervous system (CNS) / brain metastases.
3. Uncontrolled active interstitial lung disease (ILD) or pneumonitis.

trials.title: Phase III Randomized Trial of ADC-HER3 vs Platinum Chemotherapy After Progression on Third-Generation EGFR TKI in NSCLC
trials.briefTitle: HER3-ADC Post-Osimertinib Study in EGFR+ NSCLC
trials.summary: Phase III study for patients with EGFR-mutated metastatic NSCLC who have documented radiographic progression after prior third-generation EGFR TKI therapy such as osimertinib.
trials.eligibilityCriteriaRaw:
Inclusion Criteria:
1. Age >= 18 years.
2. Pathologically documented Stage IV NSCLC with EGFR Exon 19 deletion or L858R.
3. Required prior progression on at least one third-generation EGFR TKI (e.g., osimertinib).
4. ECOG performance status <= 1.
5. Platelets >= 100000 /µL and ANC >= 1500 /µL.

Exclusion Criteria:
1. History of interstitial lung disease (ILD) requiring systemic steroids.

trials.title: Phase II/III Study of TROP2-Directed Antibody-Drug Conjugate Plus Checkpoint Inhibitor in Advanced Triple-Negative Breast Cancer
trials.sponsor: Breast Oncology Translational Network (Synthetic Demo Sponsor)
trials.summary: Assesses progression-free survival in adult patients with locally advanced inoperable or metastatic triple-negative breast cancer with documented PD-L1 CPS scoring and adequate hepatic/cardiac function.
trials.eligibilityCriteriaRaw:
Inclusion Criteria:
1. Age >= 18 years.
2. Histologically confirmed Triple-Negative Breast Cancer (TNBC), Stage IIIB or Stage IV.
3. Documented PD-L1 Combined Positive Score (CPS >= 10) from central or validated local pathology.
4. ECOG performance status 0 or 1.
5. Adequate hepatic function: AST <= 120 U/L, ALT <= 120 U/L, Total Bilirubin <= 1.5 mg/dL.
6. Left Ventricular Ejection Fraction (LVEF) >= 50% documented within 90 days.

Exclusion Criteria:
1. Prior therapy with a topoisomerase I inhibitor antibody-drug conjugate.

structuredCriteria.originalText: Histologically confirmed Triple-Negative Breast Cancer (TNBC), Stage IIIB or Stage IV.

trials.sponsor: Rocky Mountain Immunotherapy Alliance (Synthetic Demo Sponsor)
trials.summary: Investigational trial evaluating individualized neoantigen therapy plus PD-1 inhibition in adults with Stage IIIB–IV BRAF V600E cutaneous melanoma without active untreated brain metastases.
trials.eligibilityCriteriaRaw:
Inclusion Criteria:
1. Age >= 18 years.
2. Histologically confirmed Stage IIIB, IIIC, or Stage IV Cutaneous Melanoma with BRAF V600E mutation.
3. ECOG performance status 0 or 1.
4. ANC >= 1500 /µL and eGFR >= 45 mL/min.

Exclusion Criteria:
1. Active or untreated brain / CNS metastases on screening neuroimaging.
